summary: Cerebras Inference grants every new cloud account $5 in free credit for its wafer-scale inference API, which serves open models at extremely high tokens-per-second. Prototype prompts, agents, and real-time apps before spending anything.
claim_steps: Open www.cerebras.ai/inference and click 'Get API Key' / free trial.
Create a free Cerebras Cloud account.
Generate an API key from the console.
Point your OpenAI-compatible client at the Cerebras endpoint; the $5 credit covers your first usage.
